What is the binary number 10101111 in hexadecimal?

questions.explain: Shifting left by 1 multiplies by 2: 12 x 2 = 24.

questions.q: What is the result of the binary addition 00110110 + 00001111?

options: The result is too large to fit in the available number of bits
The computer stores the number as text

questions.q: An image is 16 pixels wide and 16 pixels high with a colour depth of 8 bits. What is its file size?
questions.explain: 16 x 16 = 256 pixels x 8 bits = 2048 bits = 256 bytes.

questions.q: Unicode can represent many more characters than ASCII.
Lossless compression permanently removes some of the data.
questions.explain: Lossy compression removes data; lossless compression can restore the original exactly.

questions.q: A higher sample rate gives more accurate sound but a larger file.
The hexadecimal digit F is equal to 16 in decimal.
Hexadecimal is base ____.
Shifting a binary number one place to the left multiplies it by ____.
The number of sound samples taken each second is called the sample ____.
When a binary addition produces a result that does not fit in the available bits, this is called ____.
Convert the hexadecimal number 3C into binary and into decimal.
Explain the difference between lossy and lossless compression.
questions.answer: Lossy compression makes the file smaller by permanently removing some data (1); lossless compression makes it smaller without losing any data, so the original can be rebuilt (1).
